transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Tech support.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Hi, my internet is completely down. I've been trying to work from home all morning and this is incredibly frustrating. I have a major deadline coming up.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: What's the account number.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Okay, waiting for my system to load.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: So yeah, it just went out this morning, the light on the box is flashing red. I tried unplugging it and plugging it back in but nothing happened.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Tell me the account number again.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I just gave it to you. It's 883-992-110. The name is John Smith.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Right. Is it plugged in?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Yes, I just told you I unplugged it and plugged it back in.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Well I need to verify. What color is the light?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Flashing red. Like I said.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Let me look at the account.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: The sales team messed up your account when you upgraded yesterday. They didn't provision it right.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Are you kidding me? They told me it wouldn't affect my connection at all. Can you just fix it?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm trying. You have to wait.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Can you at least tell me how long it will take?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I don't know. The system is slow today.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Look, I have a meeting in 30 minutes. Is there anything we can do right now to speed this up?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Go to the router and look at the back.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Okay, I'm there.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Read me the MAC address.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: And the serial number?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: The serial number is SN-987654321. Why do you need this if the sales team messed up my profile?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Just following the steps.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Now unscrew the cable from the wall.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: The coax cable? It's really tight. Let me get a wrench.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Okay, I got it off. Now what?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Wait five seconds.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Now screw it back on.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Okay, it's screwed back on. The light is still flashing red.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Of course it is. I haven't fixed the profile yet.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Then why did you have me do that?!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Process.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: This is absolutely ridiculous.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: The system is asking for another code. Look on the bottom of the router.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I don't see any other codes.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Look closer.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Oh, there is a tiny sticker. P-I-N 1-2-3-4. Is that it?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's telling me that's wrong. Are you sure you read it right?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I am staring right at it. It says 1-2-3-4.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Well, the database says it should be different. The warehouse must have mixed up the boxes. They always do this.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Okay, so what do we do now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I have to manually override it.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: How is that manual override going?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Still typing.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I'm really stressed out here. My boss is going to be furious.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have a paperclip?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Yes, why?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Push the reset button on the back of the router for 30 seconds.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I'm pushing it.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Okay, 30 seconds. It's rebooting.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: It's still flashing red.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I know. I'm still doing the override.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: You are making me do things that have no effect while you type?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It prepares the device.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: This is taking forever.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yep.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Do you have an ETA at all?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: When it's done.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I got an error message. Let me try again.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: What was the error?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It just said error. Our IT department makes terrible software. It's not my fault.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I don't care whose fault it is, I just need it fixed.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm pressing the button again.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Did the button work this time?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's spinning.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Still spinning?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Try rebooting your computer now.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: My computer? The router light is still red. The internet isn't reaching the house.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Just reboot the computer. It refreshes the network card.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Fine. Rebooting.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Okay, computer is back on. Still no internet. Router is still flashing red.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Okay, the system stopped spinning.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: So is it fixed?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No. I have to go to the next screen.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Please tell me we are almost done.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: We are on step 4 of 5.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Okay, I am on the final screen. I need you to unplug everything again.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Seriously?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes. Unplug the power, the coax, the ethernet. Everything.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Okay, it's all unplugged.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Leave it off for two minutes.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Okay, plug the coax in.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Okay, coax is in.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Now plug the power in.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Power is in. Lights are coming on.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Now plug the ethernet in.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Ethernet is in.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Now we wait for it to boot.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: It's still flashing red. Wait, no, it's flashing orange now.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Now it's solid green.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yep, I pushed the final profile to it.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: So it should be working?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Check your computer.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Let me open a browser... Yes, it's loading. Finally!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yeah.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Look, I'm really glad it's fixed, but this process was excruciating.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Well, the sales team shouldn't have broken it. I fixed it for you.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I'm just glad I can finally get to work. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Bye.
